summary: Frontend regression test of UserEditModal Schritt-2 refactoring (5 sub-components extracted into /admin/user_modal/). All required data-testids render correctly when the modal is opened for Kunde, Mitarbeiter and Freelancer roles. Conditional fields appear/disappear correctly when their parent toggle is flipped. No regressions vs. iteration_71 (the previous full-modal test).

issues: Console warning (a11y): 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' — pre-existing, already flagged in iteration_71.

critical_code_review_comments: Refactor was a clean 1:1 JSX extraction — props are correctly forwarded (formData, setFormData, updateFilesharingApp, updateGeneratorMonitoringApp, updateEnergyMonitoringApp, toggleGeneratorId, toggleEnergyDeviceId, allGenerators, allMesskoffer, freelancer-Setter). All data-testids preserved.

AccountAvailabilityCard line 9: signature receives formData+setFormData directly — note the wrapper at UserEditModal:254 has a redundant `formData.role === 'kunde'` check, since this whole block is already inside the kunde-only branch (line 227). Minor dead-code, not a bug.

Pre-existing console error 'Encountered two children with the same key, dev-test-dse890-fix-fbd8701a' appears in GeneratorMonitoringCard's generator list when the gm-toggle is opened — duplicate generator IDs in /api/generators response, not introduced by this refactor.
Pre-existing a11y warning (Missing Description for DialogContent) still emitted — same as iteration_71.
All 5 sub-components are now small (61–150 LOC) and focused. UserEditModal.jsx is down from 717 → 295 LOC as advertised. Good separation.
